findings.reason: without a statement that settle detection and the sweep leave the follower (or an s8→§10 dependency), the section's own trace measure cannot pass on the subscriber it deploys, so the node either fails its gate or reaches into §10's mechanism.
findings.text: §8 states "The follower computes no snapshot, reads nothing on GPFS" and its measure at :264 requires a 60 s `strace -f -e trace=openat,stat,newfstatat` of a running subscriber to name no path under the crew home other than the two lease files, but the deployed subscriber is settle-aware (`settle: bool = False` defaults off, yet the session host runs settle-aware followers): `_check_settle` (reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1517) samples every `FOLLOWER_SETTLE_SAMPLE_SECONDS = 1.0` (:312) and calls `_population_has_live_work` (:1508) -> `runs._list_live_records` (:497), which reads the crew-home live-pointer directory; `_check_settle` runs on every wait pass (:1759), and the resumption sweep runs on its own cadence (`_sweep_on_cadence` -> `resumption.sweep`, :1790, DEFAULT_SWEEP_SECONDS = 120). §8 neither states that these leave the follower nor declares a dependency on §10, which owns moving settle detection and the sweep into the station, so a node grading the trace on a settle-aware subscriber sees live-pointer opens under the crew home and fails the gate, or must implement §10's removal out of scope.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — tests/test_a_delivered_row_does_not_round_trip.py, tests/test_a_dispatch_is_one_row.py, tests/test_crew_session_delivery.py, tests/test_follower_freshness.py and its test_running_follower_reloads_without_stream_or_registration_gap all exist; runs.renew_producer_lease, runs.follower_dir, follow_checkpoint.checkpoint_path/history_path and ticker.PaneRowPath all resolve; the extensionless hrefs (/reckon/research/monitor-storage-load-rca, /reckon/plans/the-monitor-shows-the-work-it-watches) resolve as `<path>.html`.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §8's done-when is measurable (existing pane tests, retargeted reload test, six new tests, a 60 s trace measure) and names two declared negative controls (no persisted cursor, checkpoint still written each draw).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate is the repository's test files and a trace, and the plan's evidence link resolves to the archive document.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan labels, ticket numbers or version tags reach code symbols; the prose's "old §77" is a plan-internal reference, and the new prose states the mechanism (cursor pair, generation counter) rather than a tracker entry.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §8 asserts the follower "reads nothing on GPFS" and its trace measure allows no crew-home path other than the two lease files, but the settle-aware subscriber the session host runs samples its population every 1 s and reads the crew-home live-pointer directory, and no section states that settle detection and the resumption sweep leave the follower.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §8 names one deliverable, the follower becoming a query-and-painter subscriber, and the lease continuance is a stated interim constraint on that one goal rather than a second deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §8's declared dependency on §7 resolves, and the sections it names (§5 store, §7 station) exist; the settle coupling below is a mechanism/scope defect rather than a wrong depends-on edge.
